blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The verified USDF token source exposes an ADMIN_ROLE-gated pause() function. Its paused transfer hook makes the contract-wide transfer path directly restrictable by the administrator, regardless of the separate inferred upstream exposure.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: OpenAI Codex Safety Score V9 access review

oracleRisk.summary: Aster manages USDF backing through custodial USDT and offchain delta-neutral positions, without publishing a user-CDP liquidation oracle or market-specific feed inventory.

branchApplicability.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 data research
branchApplicability.rationale: USDF mints and redeems against USDT while Aster manages backing and hedge positions through Ceffu and Binance. Holders do not open permissionless collateralized debt positions with onchain per-collateral liquidation thresholds, auctions, backstops, or shutdown branches, so the V9 CDP branch inventory does not apply.
